title: x3d-ray
subtitle: HagopJay's X3D repo family: {family_span.commits} commits on {family_span.active_days} days, {family_span.first|date} to {family_span.last|date}

author.prose: Claude, in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-31
author.numbers: none: every number below is a slot that x3dray/spec.py fills from profile.json
author.checked_by: the fact gate (x3dray/spec.py check, run by x3dray/gates.py)

views.label: Overview
views.caption: Six instruments on one film. Left, the tie constellation; centre, the time helix; right, the code city; above, the concept lattices and the bridges; in front, the pipeline that drew them all. That pipeline, x3d.xray, is itself one of the repos it reads.

claim.text: x3d.xray x-rays {family_span.repos} repos of git history, and it is one of them.

views.label: Helix
views.caption: Time runs left to right, one turn per active day: {family_span.active_days} days from {family_span.first|date} to {family_span.last|date}. Angle is the hour of day (UTC), radius is the repo, colour is who committed, size is lines changed. Coral threads join the commits of one Claude session.

claim.text: {family_span.commits} own commits over {family_span.active_days} active days, from {family_span.first|date} to {family_span.last|date}.

views.label: Busiest month
views.caption: {busiest_month.commits} of {busiest_month.total} commits ({busiest_month.share|pct}) landed in {busiest_month.month_name}. A turn widens with the day's activity, so busy days take the most room and quiet weeks shrink to a gap marker.

claim.text: {busiest_month.month_name} holds {busiest_month.share|pct} of the family's own commits.

views.label: Peak day
views.caption: The bright ring is {busiest_day.day|date}: {busiest_day.commits} commits, {busiest_day.top_commits} of them in {busiest_day.top_repo} and {busiest_day.second_commits} in {busiest_day.second_repo}.

claim.text: {busiest_day.day|date} is the busiest day: {busiest_day.commits} commits, {busiest_day.top_commits} of them in {busiest_day.top_repo}.

views.label: Rhythm
views.caption: Looking down the time axis turns the helix into a clock face. HagopJay's accounts peak at {rhythm.you_peak|hour}; Claude's busiest hour is {rhythm.ai_peak|hour}. The bars around the rim count each hour's commits, HagopJay outside, Claude inside.

claim.text: HagopJay's commits peak at {rhythm.you_peak|hour}; Claude's peak at {rhythm.ai_peak|hour}.

views.label: Claude
views.caption: Coral is Claude: {who_commits.counts.ai} of {family_span.commits} commits ({who_commits.shares.ai|pct}), and {self:claude_in_the_data.sessions} Claude sessions left a session trailer. Its share runs from {ai_share_by_repo.shares.KeGG|pct} of KeGG to {ai_share_by_repo.shares.graphify|pct} of graphify. Another {pairing.commits} commits under HagopJay's names carry a Claude co-author trailer.

claim.text: Claude made {who_commits.shares.ai|pct} of all own commits; the other denominators are one question away.

views.label: Ties
views.caption: Spheres are repos, sized by their own commits. Straight lines are the {ties_machine.pairs} tie pairs the machine found; arcs are the {ties_curated.ties} ties the fork masterclass graded by hand. Green is Confirmed, yellow Likely, orange Suspected.

claim.text: Every tie drawn has a witness: {ties_machine.pairs} pairs found by rule and {ties_curated.ties} graded by hand.

views.label: Fork hub
views.caption: The x3d_mcp fork is the hub: {pins.top_target_share|pct} of the {pins.total|n} commit hashes written across repos point at {pins.top_target}. The most cited, {pins.top.0.repo} commit {pins.top.0.sha|raw}, is cited {pins.top.0.count|n} times.

claim.text: The x3d_mcp fork is the hub: {pins.top_target_share|pct} of the commit hashes written across repos point at it.

views.label: Code city
views.caption: Each district is one repo at its tip and each building one file: height is lines, colour is kind, a hot roof marks heavy rewriting. x3d.ML alone holds {repo:x3d.ML/x3d_files|n} of the {x3d_assets.total|n} X3D files.

claim.text: x3d.ML holds {repo:x3d.ML/x3d_files|n} of the family's {x3d_assets.total|n} X3D files.

views.label: Hotspots
views.caption: The tallest heat in the fork comes from vendored X3D schemas, so lines changed flatter x3d_mcp. Its tests are its own: {repo:x3d_mcp/tests|n} test functions at the tip.

claim.text: The fork's heaviest rewrites are vendored X3D schemas, not new code.

views.label: Concepts
views.caption: Leaving out mass edits, merges and private commits, each counted under excluded: each sphere is a concept, a set of kinds of author with every file all of them touched. {concepts_files.only.ai} files were touched only by Claude, {concepts_files.only.you} only by HagopJay's accounts and {concepts_files.you_ai} by both. The small lattice sorts the repos the same way, counting every commit but merges. A file missing here is not an untouched file.

claim.text: Leaving out mass edits, merges and private commits, {concepts_files.you_ai} of {concepts_files.n_files} files carry commits by both HagopJay and Claude.

views.label: Bridges
views.caption: Left, the Claude-session graph: {bridges_sessions.multi} of the {bridges_sessions.sessions} sessions that left a trailer committed to more than one repo; gold rings mark what lies on every session path between two repos. Right, per repo with a cluster of ten or more files, the file on the most shortest paths between others, high churn kept and set aside. {bridges_sessions.without_trailer|n} own commits carry no session trailer, so two repos with no recorded session link may still be tied.

claim.text: In the Claude-session graph, {bridges_sessions.passage.via} lies on every path between {bridges_sessions.passage.a} and {bridges_sessions.passage.b}.

views.label: The tool
views.caption: This row is x3d.xray: one block per stage of the pipeline that drew this page, with its modules and their code hashes. Grey stages run no model; coral stages are where Claude writes. Commits of x3d.xray in the data it drew: {self:in_its_own_data.commits_in_data}.

claim.text: Code draws every shape and fills every number; Claude writes only the captions and the answers.

tour.title: Six instruments
tour.caption: One scene, six readings drawn from the same {family_span.commits} commits: who and when (the helix), what ties to what (the constellation), what is there now (the city), who touched what and what links what (the two diagrams above, each naming what it set aside), and how this page was made (the row in front).

tour.title: Reading the helix
tour.caption: One turn per active day, the hour as the angle, the repo as the radius. Amber is HagopJay, coral Claude, sage the bots.

tour.title: The busiest month
tour.caption: {busiest_month.share|pct} of all commits fall in {busiest_month.month_name}. Most of the family as it stands was built that month.

tour.title: The busiest day
tour.caption: {busiest_day.day|date} carried {busiest_day.commits} commits. {busiest_day.top_repo} led with {busiest_day.top_commits}, then {busiest_day.second_repo} with {busiest_day.second_commits}.

tour.title: Two clocks
tour.caption: HagopJay's accounts cluster at {rhythm.you_peak|hour}, Claude at {rhythm.ai_peak|hour}. The bars on the rim show the whole day.

tour.title: What Claude wrote
tour.caption: X-ray on: only Claude's {who_commits.counts.ai} commits stay lit. Its share runs from {ai_share_by_repo.shares.KeGG|pct} of KeGG to {ai_share_by_repo.shares.graphify|pct} of graphify.

tour.title: Two ways to find ties
tour.caption: The machine found {ties_machine.pairs} pairs by rule; the masterclass graded {ties_curated.ties} ties by reading. Where a line has no arc, only the machine saw it; where an arc has no line, only a reader did.

tour.title: The fork as hub
tour.caption: {pins.total|n} commit hashes written in one repo point at another, and {pins.top_target_share|pct} of them point at {pins.top_target}: CI pins, fixtures and verdicts that name a fork commit (ties E08, E09 and E28).

tour.title: What is there now
tour.caption: The city is the tip of each repo. x3d.ML is the widest district, with {repo:x3d.ML/files|n} files.

tour.title: Heat is not effort
tour.caption: The hottest roofs are vendored schemas: one commit can add tens of thousands of lines nobody typed. The fork's {repo:x3d_mcp/tests|n} test functions are the better measure of its work.

tour.title: Who touched what
tour.caption: Formal concept analysis groups the {concepts_files.n_files} files that usable commits touched by exactly who touched them. Rules come from the same idea: {concepts_rules.rules.0.if} => {concepts_rules.rules.0.then} holds in {concepts_rules.rules.0.both} of {concepts_rules.rules.0.support} commits, and the tool names the commits that break it.

tour.title: What links what
tour.caption: Betweenness asks what sits between other things. In the Claude-session graph, {bridges_sessions.passage.via} lies on every path between {bridges_sessions.passage.a} and {bridges_sessions.passage.b}. Among files, with the high-churn files set aside, {bridges_files.lead_file|raw} in {bridges_files.lead_repo} lies on {bridges_files.lead_share|pct} of the shortest paths between the other files of its cluster.

tour.title: The tool in its own data
tour.caption: x3d.xray drew this page and is also in it: its ring in the helix, its node in the constellation, its district in the city. Ask Claude how a signal was computed and it shows the profile code behind it.
